new_hypothesis.name: letsbonk_graduation_snipe
new_hypothesis.mechanism: letsBONK.fun is the BONK ecosystem's pump.fun-equivalent launchpad. When a token's bonding curve completes, liquidity auto-migrates to Raydium AMM and the token becomes tradeable. This graduation event is structurally identical to pump.fun graduation (fresh Raydium liquidity + concentrated buy-side attention as bonding-curve participants flip to Raydium), but the BONK community is a DIFFERENT WALLET POOL than the pump.fun community. Same liquidity-survival selection mechanic that the proposed pump_fun_graduation_snipe would exploit, but on an UNDERSERVED feed — every memecoin sniper bot is watching pump.fun grads, far fewer are watching letsBONK grads. The persistence comes from community segmentation: the bot is currently catching 0% of letsBONK grads because it has no listener for them.
new_hypothesis.persistence: Three reasons the edge persists: (a) BONK community wallets don't overlap meaningfully with the bot's existing 69 tracked copy-trade wallets (those are pump.fun-era profitable wallets) — a fresh candidate stream that bypasses copy_trade lag entirely. (b) letsBONK launchpad share has grown to 15%+ of Solana launchpad volume in 2026 (+600% revenue surge per KuCoin) — non-trivial daily graduation flow. (c) Most retail sniper bots are pump.fun-monocultured; the BONK feed is less crowded so liquidity windows last longer post-graduation. (d) Free RPC monitoring via Alchemy logsSubscribe filtered to Raydium AMM init txs containing letsBONK authority program-id is a stable, free signal — no API key, no rate limit risk, no auth.
new_hypothesis.entry_rules: (1) Subscribe via ALCHEMY_SOLANA_RPC logsSubscribe to Raydium AMM init logs, filter signatures whose innerInstructions reference the letsBONK authority program (Bitquery-documented). (2) On detection, fetch DexScreener pair data within 60s of grad. (3) Buy if: liquidity_usd >= $10k AND vol_h1 >= $3k AND age_min <= 10 AND security gate (RugCheck/GoPlus) passes AND mint not in cooldown. (4) Size: 0.15x tiny per OPERATOR_AUTONOMY_GRANT lifecycle rule (untested strategy = 0.15x, same as initial GBB). (5) Exits via existing position-mgmt (8% stop, 10% trailing arm, 60-min time limit). (6) Run alongside the existing pump.fun graduation listener — they don't overlap.
new_hypothesis.data_required: ZERO new HTTP API. Only need: (a) ALCHEMY_SOLANA_RPC websocket (already configured in .env), (b) Raydium AMM program id (4ckmDgGdxQoPDLUkDT3vHgSAkzA3QRdNq5ywwY4sUSJn — public), (c) letsBONK authority program-id (publicly documented in Bitquery letsBONK API docs). Persist graduation events to sol_letsbonk_graduation_log.json schema-mirroring sol_pumpfun_graduation_log.json. Hold-duration cells reveal a U-shape: <5min N=119 stop_rate 59.7% mean -6.84%; 5-15min N=249 stop_rate 73.1% mean -5.85%; 15-60min N=369 stop_rate 66.1% mean -4.94%; **1-6h N=259 WR 44.8% (BEST WR) but stop_rate ONLY 2.7% and mean -7.38% (WORST drag at -0.488 SOL total)**. The 1-6h bucket carries the highest WR but the worst SOL outcome because winners can't compensate for the few large slow-bleeders that escape the stop and exit at time-limit. Mechanism: bot's stop is 8% tight for the first hour, but as a position drifts past 60min, drawdowns can deepen past 8% during normal volatility WITHOUT triggering the stop because the stop-loss reference fades / trailing-stop arms only at +10%. Either tighten time-limit (force exits before drawdown deepens) OR widen stop after the trailing-stop window opens. Estimated retention: ~+0.32 SOL/wk if 1-6h mean loss trims from -7.4% to -3% (matching the short-bucket loss magnitude).
